notes.title: Early Access Release Date, Next Fest, and Publisher Announcement!
notes.notes: [h2]Relic Abyss is coming to Early Access on November 26, 2025![/h2][p][/p][p]We're so happy to announce that Relic Abyss will be coming to Early Access on November 26! We also have made a brand new trailer to accompany our announcement! Check it out below![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CIuj8rb0gRc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Mameshiba Games will now be publishing the game![/h2][p][/p][p]It's been a long journey this past year trying to get a publisher that would be a perfect match for the game and our team. But we've finally found them! All welcome our new publisher Mameshiba Games![/p][p][/p][p]They have given us funding, QA support, and marketing support. They are also the ones responsible for making the new Key Art and all of the new portrait changes in the game! So we know we're in good hands.[/p][p][/p][p]They will continue to support us throughout Early Access so be rest assured that we will do our best to produce the best product we can make![/p][p][/p][p]Mameshiba games will also be bringing Relic Abyss to all consoles in 2026![/p][p][/p][h2]We are joining October Next Fest![/h2][p][/p][p]Before releasing the game in Early Access, we want to make sure to join the Steam October Next Fest happening in October 14-21! Hoping that it will help us get that boost that we need for a good momentum for EA.[/p][p][/p][p]There will be a [b]major demo update[/b] on the Next Fest demo build like the rest of the difficulties in Outer Layer, the true relics (combination relics), Survivors Mode (formerly Arcade Mode), and who knows maybe a certain character will be playable then as a limited feature in Next Fest. [/p][p][/p][p]That is all for now folks! Thank you again for supporting us and playing our demo! We hope that you continue to support us throughout this whole Early Access up to the full release. See you on October 14![/p]

notes.title: No Time To Loot Event + Key Art & Illustration Revamp + new Demo & Localizations
notes.notes: [p]Greetings everyone! It's been a while! We have some amazing news regarding Relic Abyss this week! First and foremost, would like to say that this is 1 of 2 announcements we will make this week. So be sure to tune in for our second announcement as well as it's pretty special![/p][p][/p][h2]Relic Abyss has been featured in No Time to Loot steam event![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/17db6523949d7088cf2803fa716cac049ae36fca.png"][/img][/p][p]True to the event name, Relic Abyss is indeed a looter survivors-like game. So if you're interested in the types of games that feature looting, then be sure to check the event below:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/humanqube/sale/notimetolootfestival2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/humanqube/sale/notimetolootfestival2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Special thanks to Human Qube for including us in this event![/p][p][/p][h2]A brand new Key Art for the game![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/c62ac35115c9597b1ea684f3deba87af9136ff88.png"][/img][/p][p]It's been hard to keep this a secret, but one of the things we have been working on to improve are the illustrations and Key Art of the game! It's done by a wonderful new artist that has joined our team. This means, our main game artist could now focus on making gameplay art so we can now accelerate our development timeline.[/p][p]More info about it in our next announcement![/p][p][/p][h2]New Demo notes.title: Sword Celebration + 7000 Wishlists + Something special coming soon!
notes.notes: [p]Howdy everybody! It's been a while! We're gearing up for some really cool stuff coming soon! First off, we're happy to announce that Relic Abyss has been featured in another steam event called Sword Celebration happening on September 1-8th![/p][h2]Sword Celebration Steam Sale[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/44fcb67e7119a6aea06e1b2dabb4497333735195.png"][/img][/p][p]It's a pretty neat event that features games that have swords or featuring swords. It's the perfect time to start Swordtember! [/p][p]You can check out the Steam Sale event here:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/mythwright/sale/swordcelebration2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/mythwright/sale/swordcelebration2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We all know we've released the Bladefall Relic [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3017760/view/509582475187455866"]on a previous patch[/url]. If you haven't tried it yet, it's the best time to do it now! Again, the demo will be up permanently in case anyone has missed it![/p][p][/p][h2]Relic Abyss has reached 7000 Wishlists![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/88d49bfdcfff3d7dbe01e1f3d13f4614a8cbfc2d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]It's been 3 months since we released Relic Abyss's Demo to the public. And I'm happy to say that 7000 people have wishlisted our game! Wow! That's a lot of people! Thank you so much for all the wishlists! As a small game dev team, it means the world to us that we got so many wishlists for our game. If you haven't yet, and you have loved the demo, please do considering wishlisting the game as it really helps us a lot![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017760/Relic_Abyss/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We've also received a lot of feedback that helped us improve the game. With your help we have significantly improved the game since our initial demo release on May. We did 12 public demo updates since then and we're now on a more stable build v0.4.31![/p][p][/p][p]If you missed it, we also did a localization update a while back that add support to Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean![/p][p][/p][p]We have more localization coming soon:[/p][p]Brazilian, Spanish, Russian, French, and Japanese![/p][p][/p][h2]A special announcement coming late September[/h2][p][/p][p]We've been working hard and we're excited to announce something really special coming this late September! It is something that we have been working towards since we have released the demo in May. Please look forward to it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/6f7fb488315cf2aa629dec5944a11be7d0ffed9d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here's a small teaser. Let me know if you figure it out what it is in the comments below. I'll give you a cookie. :D[/p][p][/p][p]Anyways that's it for now! Just wanted to do an update in case people think we're dead haha! We're pretty much alive and well and are super excited for what's in store this late September![/p]

notes.title: East Asia Indie Games Celebration + Chinese & Korean Demo Localization!
notes.notes: [p]Greetings![/p][p]We happy to announce that we are a part of the 2025 East Asia Indie Games Celebration! To celebrate this, we have released the Simplified and Traditional Chinese versions of our demo![/p][p][/p][p]诚挚邀请试玩圣物深渊（Relic Abyss）简体中文试玩版[/p][p]本团队已参与二零二五年东亚独立游戏庆典（East Asia Indie Games Celebration 2025）！为庆祝这一盛事，本团队已发布圣物深渊（Relic Abyss）简体中文试玩版！现诚挚邀请阁下成为首批体验此游戏的创作者。[/p][p][/p][p]敝團隊已參與二零二五年東亞獨立遊戲慶典（East Asia Indie Games Celebration 2025）！為慶祝這一盛事，敝團隊已發布聖物深淵（Relic Abyss）繁體中文試玩版！現誠摯邀請閣下成為首批體驗此遊戲的創作者。[/p][p][/p][p]\[Relic Abyss] 애니메이션에서 영감을 받아 만들어진 액션 로그라이트 RPG의 한국어 버전 데모가 공개되었습니다![/p][p]저희 게임이 2025년 8월 5일부터 19일까지 진행되는 스팀 동아시아 인디 게임 셀레브레이션에 참가하게 되어, 해당 행사를 위해 게임의 한국어 버전을 추가 공개했습니다. 저희 게임을 플레이하고, 한국에 알려주실 첫 크리에이터가 되어주셨으면 합니다![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/4d0b084146f016607bf217c8bb69cd7b477e5540.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You may now access the Korean, Chinese Simplified and Chinese Traditional localizations of the game by clicking the drop down on the Title Screen or on the Settings menu![/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/a60a311f30870bfd715bb1d2dd669110016f58bc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/737750792581cf32e0dce45e2b6d6f00a344fdd6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/0982e464304b941bcb377d0a054ac66f84f3c722.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/bc1611db555955c91c9bf47d77821dcd914e13f8.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/c64976d4ce02dbfd12a8281b08ca53f34a63f5ae.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/8ab7b90e746cece10d68da4aed7a930b3d878557.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/27a314170807f27fe23678828940eb2141fad0e8.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Thank you again everyone for the patience and for playing the game! More updates and Localizations are coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]Play the demo here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694300/Relic_Abyss_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Quick Rewards Bug Fix Patch and Rewards Reset. Relic Abyss v0.4.26
notes.notes: [p]Hi! Someone from our discord server let us know that there was a bug that prevents you from getting rewards if you hit continue after the first Event Notifier upon finishing the level.[/p][p][/p][p]We are really sorry if you have lost any rewards during this period. We have uploaded a fix for this and have reset all of the rewards in all difficulties. So you can claim it again after finishing the levels even after you have finished it.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Note: Rewards can only be claimed once per difficulty![/i][/p]

notes.title: New Relic: Spiral Key + Some good news about the game. - Relic Abyss v0.4.23
notes.notes: [p]Heya gang! Long time no see! Just want to talk about what has happened since our last update. Why I stopped updating for a while, what changed in the game, and what's in store for the future.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Build:[/h2][p]Starting last week, I've been finally back improving the game and adding more stuff to the demo. Below are the new changes that has come with the new build version 0.4.23![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/cc8bdc394a217bce6581227af07df64e9c3630f9.gif"][/img][/p][p]Change Log:[/p][list][*][p]Implemented new Physical Relic: Spiral Key[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Attack Speed / Cooldown able to go above the maximum attackspeed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed perk item highlight not aligned properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new SFX to Bladefall Relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hovering on perks scrollbar can hover side buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Event Notifier still popping up after buying items on shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dropping an item will 100% black screen on swapping characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed spamming pause on after selecting level can cause a soft lock.[/p][/*][*][p]Added hotkey to confirm on Results Screen, Character Select, and Level Select.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Stats Screen Rework:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/357e8e73947465790f0b66f0b639b96fdc154803.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Luck now affects loot quality and have a chance to spawn another perk.[/p][/*][*][p]Added toggle to stop the stats screen from popping up every level.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Auto Stats feature:[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking auto now brings up stat toggles that distributes your points automatically based on your choices.[/p][/*][*][p]If open on level is off and auto is on, stats will automatically assign upon levelling up.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Why I stopped updating for a while...[/h2][p]Sorry for not posting for a while. As I've told on a previous announcement before we we're dropped by the publisher we've been working with since 2024. And because of this, we really didn't had any funding since April 2025. So in our last ditch effort, we've decided to just release the demo and see where it would take us.[/p][p][/p][p]Thankfully, the demo release was a success, thanks to everyone who played our game! I'll be making another announcement post regarding the demo results in the future. But for now, thanks again everyone for playing our game![/p][p][/p][p]Around the 2nd week of June, we were out of funds. So we had to pause development for a bit and we went back seeking funding for the game. I emailed a lot of publishers, I applied for jobs, I talked to investors.[/p][p][/p][h2]Some good news![/h2][p]It was a pretty long process, but after 2 more weeks of talking to them, we've finally found someone who was interested in funding our game![/p][p][/p][p]I can't say any details for now, but starting this week, we finally have our game funded! And we can say with full confidence that we are now able to finish our game 100%! [/p][p][/p][p]Will talk about it more in the future but for now this is all I can say![/p][p][/p][h2]Coming soon:[/h2][p]We have also planning on some more future stuff planned coming soon. Like Localizations for different languages.[/p][p][/p][p]These languages are currently in the works and will be implented as soon as they're finished:[/p][list][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Traditional Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Brazilian[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]More languages are coming in the future![/p]

notes.title: Gold Fix + Hitboxes and other things - Relic Abyss Demo v0.4.16
notes.notes:
Hello! I've fixed a couple of bugs that have spawned from the previous build. Mainly the gold stuff. But don't worry, it's just a HUD issue so no progress is lost. And I also did some other quality of life improvements too. Check them out!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed HUD gold value not displaying
[*] Fixed All gold alignments not updating
[*] Enlarged Level Select scrollbars
[*] Fixed able to purchase 0 "empty items" at shop
[*] Fixed difficulty text from glitching out when changing difficulty on the same level
[*] Removed exploit: Able to sell negative items to gain gold.
[*] Increased shop sold cards to 3.
[*] Damage numbers spawn on enemies for AoE skills
[*] Buffed Pyotyr's Consecrated Earth damage scaling
[*] Removed Randomness on Warrior's Slash Attack
[*] Buffed duration of Warrior Battle Shout
[*] Adjusted player and enemy hitboxes
[*] You can now dash on the HUB
[/list]

Also huge shoutout to Idle Cub for making a video about our game! I know some of you came from that video so hello and welcome to you all! I hope you enjoy the game and really sorry for the bugs! (I'm just a solo dev)

We're moving the big update on Friday or Saturday because the powerplant in our city has been busted and our power has been on and off for the past 3 days now. Will surely let you know once the Major update is playable!

notes.title: Hotfix: Storage deleting items - Relic Abyss v0.4.14
notes.notes:
Hello! Some players have reported that items they store on the community storage chest can sometimes go missing. We have investigated and have addressed the issue on this new build!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/a14d9e1c67070d7c0d80eeb6178c41ede4b2652f.png[/img]

Changelog:
- Fixed Items getting removed from storage after swaping 2 items on storage UI
- Fixed duplication exploit in storage when exiting while holding an item
- Fixed Storage UI scrollbar starting at the middle upon opening
- Fixed Swapping characters can soft lock the game

Would like to personally apologize to everyone who have lost their items. I hope that doesn't dissuade you from continuing to play the game or looking forward to the future. The demo release was the first public demo release of the game so we are continuously working on improving the game. Thank you again for all of your feedback!

notes.title: Resolution + Fullscreen settings fix
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Just uploaded a new build version 0.4.12!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/6ce466cb0eaeaba0b69644df434c09227fcb3809.png[/img]

Changelog:

- You can now change resolutions by using the Resolutions Dropdown menu under Graphics settings

notes.title: Relic Abyss Demo Release Announcement + Trailer + Updates
notes.notes:
We're alive!! Hello everyone! We're sorry for the lack of updates these past 5 months! We've been through a really long journey, and I want to share that right here!

But firstly, some good news!

[h1]Relic Abyss Demo Releases on May 27, 2025 at 9 am EST! Check out our new Trailer![/h1]

Been a wild ride, but after two years of development, we have finally finished our demo and you can finally play it on May 27!

We've also made a shiny new Trailer to accompany this announcement! Please check it out!
[previewyoutube=R52cTG1CyBA;full][/previewyoutube]

We've worked really hard on it so we can't wait for you all to experience the work that we've done!

If you like what you've seen, please don't forget to wishlist the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017760/Relic_Abyss/

[h2]Why did the demo get delayed?[/h2]

Now for the painful part of this announcement. The past year was pretty rough for us. We've worked hard to make a Pitch Deck and started pitching to publishers. That is all to get funding to help finish the game.

After a lot of pitches and a lot of communication with several publishers, we have finally gotten one that was really interested in our game and even gave us a grant to continue it, though with the cost of first right of refusal. That means we couldn't pitch to any other publisher until we have a final answer with them.

So for the past few months, we have been working with this publisher, giving them our builds, each time hoping they will finally sign us. Our very first demo was made on September 2024, then December 2024, then April 2025. Sadly, after 3 attempts of trying to show what our game has to offer, they still ended up rejecting us 3 times.

The constant rejection not just from this publisher, but also from events we are trying to join, has taken a huge toll on our mental health. So despite the fact that we did get a little bit of funding from the grant, we felt trapped, we lost a lot of motivation and momentum. And it also messed up the possible opportunities we could have gotten with other publishers.

But despite all that, we still believed in ourselves that our game was good and has a lot of potential so we kept pushing on no matter what. The last payment we got from them was on December 2024. We managed to squeeze that grant until April, but after that when we have finally presented our final demo, they had us wait 2 more weeks till the first week of May just to shot us down again with another rejection.

So that's why we've decided that that was the last straw! We're gonna take matters into our own hands and take a hold of our own fate! No more trying to rely on others to champion our game for us. So we're letting the player decide if our game is good or not. So we will be self publishing the demo ourselves!

Initially, the reason why I wanted to get a publisher was to get the game on all platforms to reach as much people as possible. But sadly, even indie games publisher have been hit hard the past year and a lot of investors are backing out of projects due to world events.

While we are not signing off on working with any Publishers in the future, we know now how much of a pain working with them so until we get the right one, we'll be focusing on just self publishing the game.

[h2]Regarding the future[/h2]

We still need a bit of funding to finish the game. But we'll do our best these next couple of months to be self sufficient and try to get other sources of funding. While still pitching the game to other publishers. This is why we need to make sure our demo release will be a success! So we're hoping you all enjoy it when it comes out!

I'm also planning to do some content creation to document more of what we have been making and hopefully to get more people informed about the game.

If you're interested in that, here's the channel that I will be using!
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@blas_gamedev]Blas - Game dev channel[/url]

Well that's it! All that's left now is for you all to play our demo! Really sorry for taking this long, but because of that I think the demo has really been fleshed out. We can even call it a prologue now haha.

Thank you all so much again for the patience! Till next time!

notes.title: Mic test... Is this on? Bullet Heaven Fest, Teaser Trailer and Demo news?
notes.notes:
Howdy, everyone! It's been a while, huh? How are you all doing?

[h1]Bullet Heaven Fest[/h1]

First off, we'd like to announce that we're part of Bullet Heaven Fest 2.0! BHF is an annual event that celebrates the newly formed sub-genre on Steam called "Bullet Heaven."

While we describe Relic Abyss as a class-based action roguelite RPG with a light narrative set in a fantasy sci-fi world, at its core, it is a Bullet Heaven. We're so happy to be taking part in this event!

You can check out the event page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/BulletHeaven2

[h2]Regarding Bullet Heaven / Survivors-like tags[/h2]
The bullet heaven community is trying to push steam to finally include "Bullet Heaven" and "Survivors-like" tags. If you have the time, please try to add it to our game as well!

You can access the tags by pressing the + button on the tags:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/a7db9d1fcbf4592c19094d9628306f60a15a8ad1.png[/img]

Steam values player feedback above all else so in doing so, we'll let our voices heard!

[h1]Demo Teaser Trailer[/h1]

In celebration of this event, we’ve created a little teaser trailer for our upcoming demo! Please check it out!

[previewyoutube=fSZxXTocKFs;full][/previewyoutube]

At least now you all know that we are making a real game! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Regarding Our Demo[/h1]

We’ve been working tirelessly around the clock on our demo. There were a lot of mechanics to plan, so some of them took a while since they’re pretty complicated. But I'm happy to say that it’s almost done! We just need a bit more time to polish it and create a proper trailer to announce the game officially. Hopefully, it won’t be too long now, right?

That being said, there will be a demo showcase at Noble Steed Games' event called "The Games Exchange." Developers from Australia and the Philippines will exchange games to play each other’s creations and give feedback. It's happening on December 6/7 in AU and PH.

Check out this link if you’re interested in joining!
[url=https://x.com/NobleSteedAU/status/1864117805429477440]The Games Exchange[/url]

[h1]Steam Page Revamp[/h1]

For those with eagle eyes, you might have noticed a few changes to our Steam page! We wanted to reflect all the updates we’ve made since June, and in line with the BHF event, we also revamped our Steam page!

Please check it out and be sure to add us to your wishlist if you haven’t already! It really helps us get noticed here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017760/Relic_Abyss/

[h1]Regarding Our Future[/h1]

Another thing we’ve been working toward is finding a publisher who's interested in picking up our game and helping us finish it so it can reach as many people as possible. We also need some funding so we don’t starve while making it! Currently, I’m self-funding the project, so it’ll be less painful once we sign with someone.

We have a lot of prospects, but we’re happy to say we’re very close to signing with one of them! We’re really excited about this and have all our fingers crossed! We’ll let you all know as soon as we have some solid news. This is something we’ve been working toward since we announced the game in June 2024!

I guess that’s it for now, folks! Thanks for reading through all of that! Our next goals are to officially announce the game and release our demo, then hopefully join Next Fest in February. Thank you so much to everyone who has wishlisted our game — we really appreciate it!

The holidays are approaching, so I hope you all have a cozy month ahead! I'll leave you with our resident Cat Smith, Wilson.
